about_the_game: DEMO contains 8k words (~30 mins gameplay without viewing all routes), 9+ CGs, customisable mc (name + pronouns). Contains 2 jumpscares that require a specific route + input to find

short_description: You and the luckiest man in the world! How'd you end up on a strange ship with an even stranger Russian astronaut? Who knows!? A horror/romance visual novel about to finding a lonely captain someone to talk to.
